filed: 2026-11-16, before run.py ran; never edited after the run (a dated report instead)
descriptive: user, 2026-11-16 dialog (cell P2.29): Goodfire-style neuron baselines, one figure, one paragraph; no verdict on reuse, sides named as built
seen_before_filing: E155's top-240 set overlap on seven of these pairs (experiments/neuron_overlap/results: real 0.34-0.69, random 0.84-0.95, no call on 5 of 7, positive control failed 0.962 vs 0.965); E101's W0 jobs of E98's carrying neurons. No retention or top-K gain reading of any state.

definitions.firing: each block's MLP neurons, GELU output = c_proj's input, steering.Net site mlp<l>, fp32 target model
definitions.top-changed neurons: per state and block, the n_changed neurons of largest mean |firing at state - firing at W0| over the task's read rows at the read position (E155's rows, inventory of size_matched.pairs())
definitions.retention: per top-changed neuron, its n_top_windows Pile windows (pile_rows slice) of largest peak firing (max over positions, signed) at W0 and at the state; |shared| / n_top_windows; mean over the 4 x n_changed neurons. Per-neuron values saved
definitions.gain kept: kept = mean over read rows of (M1 - M0) / mean of (T1 - T0), E143's task units (log-odds of the target at the read position); T unmasked forward, M forward where each block keeps its k neurons of largest |firing| per window and position and zeroes the rest, the mask taken block by block inside the masked forward; 0 = W0, 1 = W0 + saved update. nan when mean(T1 - T0) <= 0
definitions.random-K floor: kept with k uniformly random neurons per block, window and position (torch generator random_seed), same formula
definitions.random update: per side, Gaussian per weight matrix scaled to the Frobenius norm of the side's first seed's update in that matrix (E155's random_like), seed random_seed + 1 + index; both readings
definitions.pair rule: E155's rules.call imported unchanged, on retention and on gain kept: gap = mean(reuse) - mean(new); band = larger within-side max - min, measured here; 'reuse side higher' iff gap > band, 'new side higher' iff -gap > band, else 'no call'; 'unreadable' with < 2 seeds or a nan
definitions.floor: E155's rules.floor per side: side mean minus its random update's reading

edge_cases_checked_before_filing.zero update: every firing change 0: topk of zeros picks some 32 neurons, whose Pile windows are identical at W0 and state: retention exactly 1.0; M1 - M0 exactly 0, T1 - T0 exactly 0: kept nan (the control checks the numerator, not kept)
edge_cases_checked_before_filing.tie: gap equal to band is no call (E155's tests)
edge_cases_checked_before_filing.negative or zero gain: kept nan, so that pair's call on gain kept is unreadable
edge_cases_checked_before_filing.kept above 1 or below 0: allowed and reported as read (masking can amplify a gain); not clipped

control.order: stage 0 first and alone on reference_state; any miss writes stage0.json and exits 1 before stage 1
control.C0_zero: zero update: retention exactly 1.0; top-K numerator mean(M1 - M0) exactly 0 and T numerator exactly 0
control.C0_retention: harder: the reference's top-changed neurons' c_fc rows and biases times harder_factor (every other weight W0); swapped: those rows and biases cyclically shifted by one within each block. Expected harder ~1, swapped near chance. Stop unless retention(harder) > retention(swapped) + retention_control_margin
control.C0_topk: the reference's c_proj update kept only on the k neurons per block most often in W0's top-k set on the read rows (often) and, recorded only, on the k least often (rare). Stop unless kept(often, own mask) > kept(often, random-K mask) + topk_control_margin
